title: fix: bound transcript lists when meetings are inaccessible
body:
Supersedes #181093, thanks @Bartok9.
Related: #161327

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: one `transcripts` list call can walk the entire archive when most or all meetings are inaccessible to the caller.

## User Impact

Each call examines at most 200 stored meetings. Empty and partial pages explain how to continue, so authorized older meetings remain discoverable. Existing authorization and output limits remain in effect. Offsets can shift when captures are added or deleted between calls; restart listing to refresh.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the existing `TRANSCRIPTS_LIST_MAX` at the tool's pagination owner and return `nextOffset` after every consumed row, including denied rows. This removes the unbounded automatic page walk and its repeated hard-coded page size. The necessary continuation argument, result, and instructions account for the net +10 production lines; no new budget constant or state owner is introduced.

## Evidence

- On current main `1cbfa2c57741c0a69037077bd9bf0730bd220a93`, both new real-store regressions fail: fully denied and partially accessible pages each perform 201 authorization checks instead of stopping at 200. With the fix, each stops at 200 and the next call finds the authorized older meeting.
- Final `pnpm test src/agents/tools/transcripts-tool-read.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 9 passed, 14.37 s command wall time (10.03 s Vitest duration). Includes continuation after the output limit is reached within a fetched page.
- Named sibling proof: `transcripts-tool.test.ts` (13 tests) and `agent-tools.prefix-stability.test.ts` (14 tests) passed. Touched-file oxlint, oxfmt, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Autoreview, Codex route, P0–P2, complete local candidate against the main commit above: scoped-clean, no findings. The reviewer received the authorization, store-pagination, and protocol contracts. `pr-simplify` retained the single-page owner and removed the automatic walk.
- Test growth: +36 lines with a dedicated allocation for the real-store denial and continuation regressions. Production: +10 lines; docs: +4 lines. Exact-head [CI 41350161206](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41350161206) passed in 502 s elapsed. Broad suites and live Gateway/model tests were not run locally on the production Team host; local tests used the Node runtime override.
- The contributor's code was read through GitHub and was not checked out or executed. Human commit credit is preserved in the replacement commit.
